subject: ApexCloud PO intake & net-term sequencing request
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Susan Brown <susan.brown@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ApexCloud PO intake & net-term sequencing request

Hi Susan —

Thanks for starting the onboarding process. Attaching our standard PO intake checklist and onboarding form (see attached stub). A couple of items we need to confirm before we kick off PO activation: 

- Preferred invoice endpoint: ap-invoices@redwood.com (please confirm if ApexCloud can route invoices there).
- Invoice frequency: do you submit monthly consolidated statements or per-PO invoices?
- Net terms: we typically default to Net 45 for new vendors, but we can do Net 30 for higher-priority SOC2-covered integrations. If you offer an early-pay discount, please confirm the percentage and eligible invoice window (e.g., 1.5% if paid in 15 days).
- PO sequencing: to minimize AP reconciliation work, can you annotate invoices with the PO number in the invoice header and the invoice line item reference?

Next steps from our side: once we have the onboarding form and payment routing confirmed, Finance will issue a PO and we can provide the PO number and an expected activation date. If you can return the attached onboarding form completed, that will speed things up.

Attachments: (Attachment: apex_onboarding_form.pdf - stub)

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Brown <susan.brown@apexcloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ApexCloud Procurement <procurement@apexcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:43:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ApexCloud PO intake & net-term sequencing request

Hi David —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers below and a completed onboarding form attached: 

- Invoice routing: we can send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com. We'll also CC billing@apexcloud.com for backup.
- Invoice frequency: our standard is per-PO invoices submitted monthly; we can consolidate if you provide a preferred consolidation ID.
- Net terms: ApexCloud standard is Net 45. We are open to Net 30 for POs > $25k or for customers that enroll in our accelerated remittance program.
- Early-pay discount: we offer 1.5% for payment within 15 days (applies to consolidated invoices only).
- PO annotation: yes, we will include your PO number in the invoice header and on every line item.

Attached: completed onboarding form (Attachment: apex_onboarding_form.pdf - 120KB).

If Net 45 is acceptable, we can proceed while we set up the PO. If you prefer Net 30 for the first PO to speed recognition, let me know and I can request priority from our billing team.

Best,
Susan Brown
Head of Vendor Ops
ApexCloud

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ApexCloud PO intake & net-term sequencing request

Looping the FinOps view here. Notes after reading ApexCloud's response: 

- ApexCloud completed form looks clean. They can route to ap-invoices@redwood.com which is our requirement.
- They default to Net 45; early-pay 1.5% within 15 days for consolidated invoices.
- Financial impact: Net 30 vs Net 45 on a $80k monthly run-rate: ~15 days of float ~ $330 in cost if we use financing; but if the early-pay (1.5%) is used it effectively reduces vendor cost if we pay sooner. We should decide whether to accept Net 45 and enroll in the early-pay option on an invoice-by-invoice basis.

Recommendation: Accept Net 45 and use early-pay selectively for critical go-live invoices (we can pilot for the first two months). Priyom — can you confirm whether our AP team can automate early-pay approvals via the supplier-earlypay queue?

Marissa
Director, Finance Operations

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Susan Brown <susan.brown@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ApexCloud PO intake & net-term sequencing request

Hi Susan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the completed form. Redwood will proceed with the following: 

- Payment terms: Net 45 per ApexCloud's standard.
- Early-pay: We will enroll on an invoice-by-invoice basis for go-live months; Redwood agrees to the 1.5% discount for payments made within 15 days for consolidated invoices.
- Invoice routing: Please send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com and CC billing@apexcloud.com. Include the PO number (PO: RED-78901) on the invoice header.
- PO: Attached is the generated PO for your reference (Attachment: PO-RED-78901.pdf - stub). Please countersign the MPA if you haven't already (Attachment: signed-mpa-apexcloud.pdf - stub) or use the DocuSign link below.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACX-2047

Next steps for ApexCloud: confirm receipt, countersign the MPA if needed, and confirm that billing will start referencing PO RED-78901 in incoming invoices. Once we see the first invoice with PO, Finance will queue it for processing under Net 45 and alert us if we elect early-pay.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to a smooth activation.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
